mapper.sql: SELECT t.task_id, r.execution_id, t.idempotency_key, t.trace_id, r.request_id, r.checkpoint_thread_id, t.state, r.status AS run_status, r.lease_owner, r.fence, t.input, t.limits, r.started_at, t.updated_at, r.error_code, r.error_message, r.result, r.checkpoint_id, r.runtime_event_cursor, t.version FROM p0_task t JOIN p0_run r ON r.task_id = t.task_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p0_task(task_id, idempotency_key, payload_hash, input, limits, trace_id, state) VALUES (#{task.taskId}, #{task.idempotencyKey}, #{task.payloadHash}, #{task.input,typeHandler=com.enterprise.platform.infrastructure.persistence.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{task.limits,typeHandler=com.enterprise.platform.infrastructure.persistence.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{task.traceId}, #{task.state}) ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT task_id FROM p0_task WHERE state = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 32
WHERE r.lease_owner = #{owner} AND r.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() AND t.state IN ('CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY t.created_at LIMIT 4
WHERE t.state IN ('CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND r.lease_expires_at < clock_timestamp() ORDER BY r.lease_expires_at LIMIT 100
